info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Market Information Management API
info.description: The Market Information Management API provides users with capabilities to modify existing market data, ensuring that financial records reflect the most accurate and up-to-date information. This API allows for efficient updates to market information resources, enabling financial institutions to respond to changes in market conditions promptly. Typical consumers of this API include banking and finance professionals who need to maintain compliance and data integrity. Use cases often involve adjusting market data in response to economic shifts, regulatory requirements, or internal policy changes.

patch.description: This endpoint allows for the partial update of market information associated with the specified resource ID. Users can provide only the fields that need to be updated, making it efficient for modifications.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the data required to update market information for a specific resource identified by 'RES-100045'. It should include all necessary fields that need to be modified as part of the patch operation.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the resource has been updated.
